subject: general
question: The book ‘Your Best Day is Today!’ is written by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Anupam Kher__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• Book titled ‘Your Best Day Is Today!’ written by Anupam Kher is based on his experiences during the countrywide lockdown during the coronavirus pandemic.
 
• He added his experiences, ups and downs, feelings of the time during which his mother and brother contracted the virus.
 
• Other books written by him are the biography ‘The Best Thing About You is You’ and ‘lessons life taught me unknowingly’.
 
• He has been awarded the two National Film Awards and 8 Filmfare Awards.
 
• He is also the former chairman of the Film and Television Institute of India.
